review.review_notes: Complete genuine abstract verifies human COL4A3/COL4A4 families, biopsy/renal outcomes and unresolved modifier explanations. Original full access failed; no variant-specific functional assay or isolated mechanical test is claimed.

Complete abstract and original publisher PDF Methods/Results/Discussion read at https://ijmr.org.in/content/175/2009/129/5/pdf/IJMR-129-525.pdf . Human biopsy-confirmed patients and controls were sequenced; segregation and clinical comparisons are positive, but functional causality remains qualified by the authors. The normal selected abstract is preserved separately from this authentic external full text.

The retrieved Europe PMC XML is PDF-only body/abstract/references, not full Methods; retain positive localization without fabricating a human tissue assay.

Actual selected Methods/Results and authentic publisher supplementary workbook inspected. Exact COL4A4/P53420 rows occur at row118 in sheets A. Complete MS Data Set and B. Matrisome. Human colon/liver ECM-enriched protein detection and collagen classification support location/structural context, not a tensile test or cancer mechanism.

Correct article identity and complete review abstract authenticated, but original publisher/repository full downloads failed. The specific target passage underlying the NAS assertions remains unverified. Independently established type IV membership can be retained, whereas the source-specific fibril-organization assertion remains undecided; no wrong-identifier or disproven-biology claim.

Actual human NC1 construct Methods, structures and assembly Results/Discussion read. Alpha4 crystal dodecamer is noncanonical; isolated alpha4 is monomeric in solution, mixed alpha345 yields alpha5 crystals and SPR tests alpha3/5. These are structural-interface data, not a native alpha345 reconstitution or autonomous adaptor assay.

Complete authentic abstract establishes the human 1690-aa sequence, processed-chain organization and fetal expression. Full original Methods are unavailable. Paper domain lengths remain its historical numbering; type IV heterotrimer membership is independently corroborated rather than presented as a direct assay newly read here.

Complete genuine abstract reports alpha3/alpha4/alpha5 NC1 composition, alpha4–alpha4 crosslinked dimers and domain-association evidence for a shared protomer. Publisher routes failed and an HTTP200 Elsevier response contained only metadata; no original full Methods, exact species or construct scope was recovered. This is not evidence of an alpha4 homotrimer.

Actual original Methods/Results read: human kidney-mRNA NC1(1–229), bacterial His-tagged protein, separate mammalian expression constructs, direct alphaVbeta3 SPR and partly antibody-sensitive melanoma adhesion. Melanoma growth/invasion and fragment comparisons are retained at their measured scopes. No endogenous proteolytic release, exact current-NC1 coordinate equivalence or full-domain antiangiogenesis is inferred.

Actual Methods/Results read. Synthetic human-sequence QS-13 (P53420 residues1678–1690) and its biotinylated derivative bind alpha5beta1; HUVEC migration/pseudotubes and mouse Matrigel vascularization decrease, while HUVEC proliferation does not. Direct binding, adhesion blockade and angiogenic endpoints are distinct experiments; docking is a model. Natural peptide release/activity and corresponding full-NC1 antiangiogenesis remain unresolved.

Actual selected Methods/Results/Discussion inspected for distinct synthetic collagen-IV peptides and HUVEC response/migration assays. These 19–20-residue peptides are neither full NC1 nor QS-13. Table1 sequence cells are not present in this selected cache and were not independently recovered, so no exact sequence comparison or in-vivo validation is claimed.

decision_summaries.reason: The original publisher PDF studies 45 Korean patients with biopsy-confirmed thin-basement-membrane nephropathy and 143 controls, using COL4A4 sequencing and family/clinical comparisons. G199R segregation and the proposed G1606E interpretation support a matrix-disease link, but the authors call for functional confirmation and do not directly measure network mechanics. Refine the established structural role to the collagen-specific term using independent NC1/complex evidence; do not declare every detected variant pathogenic.

The network-formation event places alpha4-containing type IV protomers in extracellular networks. The chain supplies matrix structure through association, rather than functioning as an assembly enzyme. The complete cached event summary and current participant traversal were inspected.

The integrin association event contains collagen IV as one of several extracellular collagen ligands. Its exact current entity path reaches COL4A4, but this set membership does not by itself establish an isolated alpha4 interaction with every listed integrin. The FN1 event includes extracellular collagen IV-containing material. The verified target entity path supports location; the family-level event is not an alpha4-specific affinity measurement. The complete cached event summary and current participant traversal were inspected.

The collagen VII event connects extracellular anchoring material with collagen IV-containing networks. The target is a chain within the collagen IV participant, not a demonstrated autonomous receptor or enzyme. The complete cached event summary and current participant traversal were inspected.

The laminin/nidogen event places the alpha4-containing type IV network in extracellular matrix. Current complex-membership paths substantiate the target location without implying that each isolated alpha4 chain directly contacts every component. The sulfilimine-crosslink event is extracellular and includes alpha4-containing collagen IV. The matrix supplies residues and architecture; peroxidasin generates the oxidizing chemistry. decision_summaries.reason: The original human ECM proteomics workbook contains COL4A4/P53420 in both the complete MS dataset and the Matrisome sheet, classified as a core-matrisome collagen. This RCA source supplies classification and protein detection, not a direct force measurement. The collagen-specific structural activity is supported by the integrated target network/NC1 evidence and the explicit GO collagen convention.

GO:0030199 concerns processes determining collagen fibril size and arrangement, and is a child of extracellular matrix organization. COL4A4 forms a type IV network, but not being a fibrillar collagen does not establish that it cannot influence fibrils. The complete PMID:29853175 abstract describes fibril assembly generally and does not identify a COL4A4-performed step; the original full text remains unavailable after the documented retrieval failures. Retain source-specific uncertainty rather than infer either participation or contradiction from collagen class alone. Independently established type IV trimer membership is a separate claim. This differs from the older merged COL4A1 REMOVE judgment because that collagen-class-based exclusion exceeds the available source evidence; the reopened COL4A1 assessment likewise retains UNDECIDED for this source.
decision_summaries.summary: The available review abstract discusses fibril assembly; the COL4A4-specific basis of this NAS assertion remains unverified.

decision_summaries.reason: Exact COL4A4/P53420 rows were read in the original human colon/liver ECM mass-spectrometry workbook, after the paper’s sequential extraction and insoluble-ECM enrichment. This directly supports protein detection in the sampled ECM fraction. Shared collagen biology and the basement-membrane network are consistent, but the proteomic measurement does not demonstrate cancer causality, secretion mechanism or an isolated mechanical activity.

The ancestral extracellular-matrix placement is consistent with direct human target proteomics and collagen IV architecture. All listed extant donor identities were resolved to literal current same-term records, whose evidence types vary; they are corroboration, not a replacement reconstruction of the historical IBD. The target among the descendants is legitimate positive grounding. No divergence or loss that would overturn matrix placement was established.

The alpha4 chain contributes the physical alpha3/alpha4/alpha5 network from which the glomerular basement membrane is formed and maintained. Current mouse and human same-term records support the context, while the historical PAINT node remains uninspected. Retain the inherited structural participation rather than treating the chain as merely a passive processing substrate or the target’s own descendant evidence as circular.

The source explicitly includes COL4A4-associated thin basement membranes and renal phenotypes in human families. Its complete abstract supports the positive matrix-disease association, but not every variant-specific developmental mechanism, and full access remains unavailable. Holistically, alpha4 supplies the glomerular basement-membrane network structure; retain the established process contribution with curator deference rather than infer an unsupported source error or an independent catalytic developmental activity.

The original full human study uses biopsy-confirmed thin-basement-membrane nephropathy, COL4A4 sequencing and segregation/clinical comparisons. It supports the structural disease context; it does not directly time embryonic basement-membrane formation or establish functional causality for every variant. Retain the existing glomerular basement-membrane contribution on the independently established material role of the alpha4-containing network, with that limitation on the particular IMP study.

decision_summaries.reason: Actual human NC1 constructs and crystallographic interfaces establish structural assembly information. Isolated alpha4 eluted as a monomer and crystallized in a noncanonical dodecamer whose physiological relevance the authors question; mixed alpha3/alpha4/alpha5 yielded alpha5 crystals, and SPR concerned alpha3/alpha5. This supports the collagen structural role but not a separately established alpha4 molecular-adaptor mechanism or native alpha345 reconstitution in this experiment. Refine to the existing collagen-specific structural activity without discarding the positive target structural data.

Recombinant human NC1, termed tetrastatin and reported as NC1(1–229), directly bound purified immobilized alphaVbeta3 in surface plasmon resonance assays; EDTA dissociated the complex and receptor-blocking antibody partially reduced melanoma-cell adhesion. The construct was amplified from human kidney mRNA and expressed with a bacterial affinity tag. This is an isolated-domain ligand activity, not a claim that every intact precursor state binds the receptor, that the insert exactly equals the current annotated NC1 interval, or that natural release was demonstrated. No original annotation or final replacement covers this binding activity. Synthetic QS-13 binds a different integrin, alpha5beta1, in separate experiments and is kept at its precise sequence/pharmacological scope.
decision_summaries.summary: Sequence-checked recombinant human NC1 binds immobilized alphaVbeta3 by SPR; an integrin-blocking antibody partly reduces melanoma-cell adhesion to coated NC1.
